title: 2.3 Probability — the language of uncertainty
description: Roadmap 2.3 — 14 topics, in the document's own order.
learningOutcomes: Take every topic in this section to pass 3 of the roadmap's rule: intuition, then derived on paper, then implemented from scratch.

lessons.title: Sample spaces, events, axioms of probability
lessons.description: Model uncertain experiments with outcomes and measurable events, apply the probability axioms, derive their core consequences, and verify finite models by exact enumeration and simulation.
learningObjectives: Distinguish an experiment, outcome, sample space, event, event family, and probability measure
Translate logical statements into set operations and derive complement, monotonicity, inclusion-exclusion, and union bounds from the axioms
Construct and validate finite probability models without assuming outcomes are equally likely
Implement exact enumeration and reproducible simulation while separating mathematical probability from empirical frequency
